brenham_phase5_source_truth.kmz.rationale: Upstream source-authoring-tool drift: the source KMZ's KML emits <href>files/iNN.png</href> for these 5 icons, but the KMZ archive contains only the suffixed variants (e.g., files/i46_6_0.png, files/i46_8_0.png) — not the bare files/i46.png. These are pre-existing source-side anomalies, NOT TrueLine fidelity regressions. TrueLine cannot synthesize the missing icons; the source authoring tool would need to be fixed. Documented and verified during F7f v1 implementation 2026-05-22. If any of these icons later resolve at the source, this entry must be updated to remove the now-resolved href so the WARN signal does not become silent.
